description:
Return a page of metadata for exactly one filing or profile. Kinds: person, organization, fact, relationship, facility, event, ownership. Continue until next_cursor is null. A stale-generation error requires restarting the query.

Behavior: read-only, no auth or API key, no PII, idempotent and safe to retry. The public endpoint https://mtgmon.com/mcp allows about 60 requests/min and 250 tool calls/day per client IP. Result shape is {data, meta}; meta carries available, as_of, source_scope, weighting, units, cache_status, caveats, and truncated. If meta.available is false, never report it as zero: retry after a few seconds only when meta.cache_status is 'miss' (warming); otherwise report the data as unavailable.

as_of.description: Latest disclosure date to include, YYYY-MM-DD; empty includes all dates.
as_of.title: As Of

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page of this exact query.
cursor.title: Cursor

filing_id.description: SEC filing accession. Supply this or profile_id, not both.
filing_id.title: Filing Id

kind.description: Profile or record kind; empty means all kinds.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: Maximum records per page, 1–100. All records remain accessible through next_cursor.
limit.title: Limit

name: list_sec_records

cache_status.description: Server cache state: hit; stale (older than its TTL, still served); stale-refresh; miss (warming, retry after a few seconds); failed or required-miss (not available now, a retry soon will not help); none; unknown.
cache_status.title: Cache Status

title: SEC metadata records
